name: social-platform-workspace
description: Agent orchestration workspace for the Social Platform polyrepo

scripts.// --- 1. FULL-STACK WORKSPACE LIFECYCLE: Manage the entire application stack across all backend services, frontends, and infrastructure
scripts.// --- 2. INFRASTRUCTURE SERVICES ---: Foundational data stores, cache, object storage, and observability (PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO, Jaeger)
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d iam-postgres media-postgres social-postgres stories-postgres redis minio jaeger
scripts.infra:down: docker compose stop iam-postgres media-postgres social-postgres stories-postgres redis minio jaeger
scripts.infra:restart: docker compose restart iam-postgres media-postgres social-postgres stories-postgres redis minio jaeger
scripts.infra:logs: docker compose logs -f iam-postgres media-postgres social-postgres stories-postgres redis minio jaeger
scripts.// --- 3. BACKEND SERVICES (ALL) ---: Orchestrate all 6 backend microservices together (Gateway, IAM, Media, Social, Stories, Media Worker)
scripts.backend:up: docker compose up -d --build gateway iam-service media-service social-service stories-service media-worker
scripts.backend:down: docker compose stop gateway iam-service media-service social-service stories-service media-worker
scripts.backend:build: docker compose build gateway iam-service media-service social-service stories-service media-worker
scripts.backend:restart: docker compose up -d --build --force-recreate gateway iam-service media-service social-service stories-service media-worker
scripts.backend:logs: docker compose logs -f gateway iam-service media-service social-service stories-service media-worker
scripts.// --- 4. INDIVIDUAL BACKEND SERVICES --: Granular lifecycle control for specific backend microservices
scripts.// --- 5. FRONTEND CLIENTS (ALL) ---: Orchestrate all 6 Angular web applications together (IAM, Social, Video, Shop, Stories, Portfolio)
scripts.frontend:up: docker compose up -d --build fe-iam fe-social fe-video fe-shop fe-stories fe-portfolio
scripts.frontend:down: docker compose stop fe-iam fe-social fe-video fe-shop fe-stories fe-portfolio
scripts.frontend:build: docker compose build fe-iam fe-social fe-video fe-shop fe-stories fe-portfolio
scripts.frontend:restart: docker compose up -d --build --force-recreate fe-iam fe-social fe-video fe-shop fe-stories fe-portfolio
scripts.frontend:logs: docker compose logs -f fe-iam fe-social fe-video fe-shop fe-stories fe-portfolio
scripts.// --- 6. INDIVIDUAL FRONTEND CLIENTS --: Granular lifecycle control for specific frontend web applications
scripts.// --- 7. GENERIC DYNAMIC SERVICE CONTRO: Control any arbitrary container dynamically by appending service name (e.g., npm run service:up -- fe-social)
scripts.// --- 8. MULTI-REPO GIT OPERATIONS ---: Manage git across all 13 workspace repos, or target a single repo (e.g., npm run repos:status -- fe-social)
scripts.// --- 9. WORKSPACE TOOLING & HOOKS ---: Developer setup and repository hooks installation
scripts._comment_data_destroy: Destructive command intentionally disabled: docker compose down -v --remove-orphans
